spans.s:
बुश बुश, बुष, various forms for बुस.
See rt. बुस्, p. 687, col. 1.

बुस, अम्, n. (according to Yāska) water; chaff
and other refuse of grain [cf. खले-बुसम्, निर्बुसी-
कृत]; refuse, rubbish; (अम्), n. wealth; dry cow-
dung; the thick part of sour curds or coagulated
milk; (आ), f. (in dramatic language) a younger
sister (?).
बूष बूष, a various form for बुस above.

बुस् बुस्, cl. 4. P. बुस्यति, &c., to dis-
charge, pour forth, emit, let loose; to
divide, distribute (= rt. व्युष्).
बुसस, अस्, आ, अम्, Gaṇa Tṛṇādi to Pāṇ.

बुस्त् बुस्त् [cf. rt. पुस्त्], cl. 10. P. बुस्-
तयति, -यितुम्, to honour, respect; to
disregard, treat with disrespect; to bind.

बुस्त बुस्त, अस्, अम्, m. n. the burnt ex-
terior of roast meat; the husk or shell of fruit; [cf.
चुस्त.]
